    static int[] f1 = new int[Maxn + 6];

    static int[][] f3 = new int[Maxn + 6][Maxn + 6];
    static int[][] f4 = new int[Maxn + 6][Maxn + 6];

    static void initialize() {
        C[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= Maxn; i++) {

    static int minimum(int a, int b) {

    static int absolute(int a) {

            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {

                for (int k = 1; k <= i; k++) {
                    total += absolute(k - j);

                long temp2 = (long) f2[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % Mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] % Mod;
                f2[i] = (int) ((f2[i] + temp2) % Mod);
                long temp3 = (long) f2[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % Mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % Mod;
                f2[i] = (int) ((f2[i] + temp3) % Mod);
                long temp4 = (long) f2[i - j] * f1[j - 1] % Mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % Mod;
                f2[i] = (int) ((f2[i] + temp4) % Mod);
            }
        }

        f3[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int limit = minimum(i, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                f3[i][j] = f3[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    if (i - 1 - k >= 0) {

                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int limit = minimum(i, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                f4[i][j] = f4[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {

                        f4[i][j] = (int) ((f4[i][j] + temp) % Mod);
                    }
